prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A dynamic, sunlit scene set on a quiet suburban road during daytime. The main subject is a man in his 30s, wearing a light blue athletic t-shirt and white shorts, running energetically along the right side of the street. His hair is tousled, and his expression is focused and determined, with sweat visible on his brow, capturing the intensity of his effort. The camera angle is cinematic and immersive, positioned from the open side door of a moving vehicle, partially framing the runner in the center-left of the composition. In the foreground, blurred and out of focus, are the shoulders and heads of two people leaning out of the vehicle, observing or encouraging the runner, adding a sense of immediacy and motion. The background features a sun-drenched residential neighborhood with green trees, a wire fence, and houses partially visible behind foliage. The color palette is warm and natural, with vibrant greens, soft blues, and sun-bleached tones. The lighting is bright and natural, casting crisp shadows and highlighting the summery atmosphere. The overall style is reminiscent of a handheld, documentary or road-movie aesthetic, with shallow depth of field, slight motion blur, and a sense of spontaneity and real-life action.
